sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for respective appellant that there is no direct allegation of rape against present appellants.
Main accused in the case is one Sunil Singh Dhangi.
It has been stated that prosecutrix along with main accused said to have visited house of Sunil Singh Dhangi.
Considering the role of the appellants, they may be enlarged on bail.
4 . Learned Government Advocate appearing for State has vehemently opposed the bail application and submitted that present appellants were also involved in the offence.
They are hand in gloves with the main accused.
In these circumstances, bail may not be granted to appellants.

6. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
7.
Considering the role of the present appellants, which has been described by the prosecution, I find it to be a fit case for grant of bail.
Hence, these criminal appeals filed by appellants is allowed.

It is directed that on furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only)each by the appellant along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court concerned, the appellants be released on bail.

9. The appellants shall abide by the conditions stipulated in Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. C.C. as per rules (VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE tarun Santosh Singh Gond vs State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79470306/
